name: 40m-10m QRP End-Fed Half-Wave (EFHW)
assemblySteps: Wind 2 primary turns and 14 secondary turns on the FT140-43 core (1:49 impedance transformer).
Solder the 100pF capacitor across the primary side to compensate for high-band reactance.
Mount the BNC connector and transformer board inside the enclosure.
Attach 66 ft wire radiating element and tune using an antenna analyzer.
